summary: INNOVATE Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into two supplemental indentures on July 31, 2026, amending its 10.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 and 9.5% Convertible Senior Secured Notes due 2027 to permit payment-in-kind interest for the February–July 2026 period for consenting holders. Consenting holders received a 1.5% consent fee in additional notes; non-consenting holders retain cash interest. Outstanding principal increases to $400.9M and $58.9M respectively, reducing cash interest to $3.1M and $0.5M from $19.9M and $2.7M. Related party Lancer Capital LLC consented, receiving $0.1M in additional notes. This liability management move conserves cash and signals financial stress; watch for further restructuring or covenant issues.
